phrases.latin: Pēra, in quā lapis et nux pīnea et tessella et sēmen cucurbitae erant, ē spondā lectī pendēbat
phrases.english: The bag with the stone, the pine cone, the tile and the pumpkin seed in it hung from the bed frame

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 122.
Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
